about: Matangi Rubber Limited is an Indian manufacturer of tyres, tyre flaps, inner tubes, and rubber compounds. The company operates five manufacturing facilities located across Uttarakhand, Tamil Nadu, and Madhya Pradesh, catering primarily to commercial vehicles as well as two- and three-wheeler segments.

objects.purpose: Repayment/pre-payment, in full or in part, of certain outstanding loans availed by our Company
Funding Capital Expenditure requirements for setting up green field manufacturing facility for Rubber Recycling Products (Bhind, Madhya Pradesh)
Funding Capital Expenditure requirements for setting up green field manufacturing facility for production of Solid Tyres (Bhind, Madhya Pradesh)

promoters.background: Mohit Gupta serves as Chairman and Managing Director and Manju Gupta serves as Executive Director, each having 20 years of experience in the rubber and tyre industry.

concentration.note: Top five customers contributed 91.61% of consolidated revenue from operations in FY26 and 98.17% in FY25, with significant revenue generated from primary customer JK Tyre & Industries Limited.

strengths: Well-established manufacturing setup operating five plants across Uttarakhand, Tamil Nadu, and Madhya Pradesh.
Strategically located facilities situated close to key customers, lowering logistics costs and improving operational efficiency.
Experienced promoter-led management team possessing over two decades of industry expertise in rubber and tyre production.
Comprehensive product portfolio covering tyre flaps, tubes, rubber compounds, and 2/3 wheeler tyres.

risks.title: High Customer Concentration Risk
risks.detail: The company relies heavily on a limited customer base, with the top five customers contributing 91.61% of total revenue from operations in Fiscal 2026.

risks.title: Substantial Outstanding Indebtedness
risks.detail: Total borrowings stood at ₹108.91 crore as of March 31, 2026, and outstanding bank borrowings were ₹97.56 crore as of June 30, 2026.

risks.title: Significant Supplier Concentration
risks.detail: Purchases from the top five suppliers accounted for 59.62% of total purchases in Fiscal 2026 and 57.56% in the stub period.

risks.title: Cash Flow Volatility
risks.detail: Operating cash flows fell sharply from ₹18.39 crore in Fiscal 2025 to ₹3.30 crore in Fiscal 2026 due to working capital requirements.

risks.title: Project Execution and Expansion Risks
risks.detail: Planned greenfield capex of ₹19.06 crore for rubber recycling and ₹8.44 crore for solid tyres at Bhind faces potential implementation and demand risks.

risks.title: Heavy Reliance on Key Customer
risks.detail: The business model depends extensively on contracts and job-work arrangements with key anchor customer JK Tyre & Industries Limited.

notes: FY24 figures are based on standalone restated financial statements as MG Industries Limited was acquired on October 31, 2024; FY25 and FY26 are consolidated. Stub period ended June 30, 2026 has been excluded from financial arrays.
